map.about: M6 with the district badges in the same spot of every district's area. Each shows the four districts selected in turn, so you can see the badge against the highlight. Try one in the game: add ?menuLayout=m6&badges=bl (mid, br, bm, split) to the link.

map.about: Each layout shows the four districts selected in turn: Campus (top left), Downtown (top right), Night Market (bottom left), Waterfront (bottom right). Pick one, or say what to mix (buttons from one, cards from another). Try one in the game: add ?menuLayout=m1 (m2 to m5) to the link.

ending.about: After level_20 (Maya's send-off). The animation, then the finished screen. Lines and photos are placeholders; options 1 and 2 combine well (chat first, then the photo).

items.title: 1 · Group photo + roll call
items.note: A polaroid of all six dropped onto a scrapbook page, then one closing line from each friend, a thank-you and Continue.

items.title: 2 · Final group chat
items.note: The next morning: Maya posts a coast photo, everyone reacts, the last message thanks the player; a 'The End' card with stars and Continue.

items.title: 3 · Scrapbook flip-through
items.note: The Scrapbook turns through every page you earned, then a new last page, 'The Send-off', gets its photo and a gold rosette stuck on.
